notes: Approximate date. Piloted hot beverages and snacks on the 10 minute promise

event: Swiggy launches Bolt: 10 minute food delivery from 2700+ restaurants in Bangalore Chennai Hyderabad Delhi Mumbai Pune
notes: Six cities at launch. Reached 5% of Swiggy food delivery orders within eight weeks

event: Zepto launches a separate Zepto Cafe app and expands to Delhi NCR Bengaluru Hyderabad Chennai Pune
Blinkit launches Bistro in parts of Gurugram
Swiggy launches SNACC as a separate 15 minute own brand food app in select Bengaluru pincodes
notes: Later expanded to Noida and Gurugram

event: Q3FY25 letter discloses Bistro. Others segment includes Bistro from Q3FY25 onwards
notes: Target stated as the in office market for snacks meals and beverages in 10 to 15 mins

event: Board approves change of name from Zomato Limited to Eternal Limited
Name change to Eternal Limited takes effect
Rinshul Chandra resigns as Chief Operating Officer of the food delivery business
Q4FY25 letter: Zomato Quick and Everyday shut down. "Restaurant density and kitchen infrastructure is not set up for delivering orders in 10 minutes... we did not see any incrementality in demand"
notes: The marketplace version of 10 minute delivery failed. Bistro is the owned kitchen answer to the same constraint

event: Q1FY26 letter: 38 Bistro kitchens live in Delhi NCR and Bangalore. "Generating incremental demand without cannibalizing the Zomato business"
notes: FY26 loss funding budget of INR 150 cr across Bistro Nugget and Greening India

event: Q3FY26 letter: about 45 Bistro kitchens, still two cities
notes: Early signs of product market fit cited as healthy throughput per outlet

event: Board accepts Deepinder Goyal resignation as Director MD and CEO effective 1 Feb 2026 and appoints Albinder Singh Dhindsa currently CEO of Blinkit as Chief Executive Officer
notes: The quick commerce CEO takes over the parent company

event: Board approves appointment of Deepinder Goyal as Vice Chairman and Non-Executive Director
notes: Subject to shareholder approval by postal ballot

event: Q1FY27 letter: Bistro framed against Toing and Ownly. "Our answer to the question these platforms are pretending to solve... food delivery at INR 50-150 price points"
